1. (Currently amended) A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the method comprising:
a. providing a finger palette including:
i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and
ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion;
b. securing the finger palette to a finger;
c. depositing a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette __using an applicator tool__; and
d. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination __using the applicator tool or a separate transfer tool__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further including the step of __removing the cosmetic product from a container using an applicator tool__ before depositing the cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein:
a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and
b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity, __wherein the cosmetic product remaining on the surface portion after transfer is retained for blending with additional cosmetic products or for subsequent application__.

5. (Original)

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially without protrusions extending therefrom __and is configured to facilitate scraping motion of an applicator across the surface portion without interruption__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar __and extends from a surface center to an outer perimeter without intervening ridges, grooves, or recesses__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion __such that the ring portion is removably and replaceably securable to the finger__.
